method: Every image is the live demo view (LessonDemoKit.LessonDemoView around the engine's MartyGraphicsLessonView) hosted in an offscreen NSWindow and captured with cacheDisplay after it settles. Offscreen windows have no display link, so the view's own in-between animation frames are never captured.

In-between frames are engine keyframes rendered offscreen at their scheduled times: lesson-demo --capture plans one run headless on the demo's default pacing (.estimate(wordsPerSecond: 2.5)) on an injected clock (LessonDemoKit/Capture.swift). Each animate's keyframe segment (MGKeyframeSegment.frames: the start scene, then validated engine keyframes at most 5° apart) is scheduled frame j of n at duration × j / (n − 1), as MGTween.sample plays it; the settled state replaces the last frame at the end of the segment. The tool checks that the live session produced the same keyframe scene, puts it on the board with the .direct transition and captures it.
Beat holds come from the narration timing: each beat state is shown from the time the pacing presents the beat until the next planned frame.

Learner: a scripted learner moves the slider during beat 4 from 85° to 45° in 5° steps, 0.1 s apart, starting 1 s after the beat is presented, through MGLessonController.control (the call the slider's binding makes). A slider move sends the same params command a scripted beat sends, so both go through the same checks and state path. No identical-fingerprint claim is made: the state revision counts the changes.

GIF: 640 px wide (scaled from 2048x1280 with Core Graphics high-quality interpolation), written with ImageIO, loops forever. Frame i lasts until frame i + 1's planned time, rounded cumulatively to centiseconds; the last frame is held 2 s after lessonComplete. The live view also blends linearly between neighbouring keyframes and draws new items on over 0.55 s; these frames show settled states at the planned times only.
Stills: 1366x1024-point window, 2x backing (2732x2048 pixels), not cropped (--render has no size option; the empty band below the board is part of the demo layout).
